success_output_contract.name: F_TOPK-U
success_output_contract.share_law: Under ideal independent random tape, inverse-shuffle h.word1 low bit makes z0 uniform and z1=z0 XOR M_runtime; each party receives only its local 0/1 share. For word1 arithmetic is modulo 2^64 (word0 alone is masked to comparison_bits); the LSB identity is exact.
basis: S25 inverse-shuffle e0/e1 include opposite signs of the independently sampled h vector; the returned shuffled_share is formed from input share plus e, before r_share is used for the public-masked lane.
Output uses word1 LSB; uint64_t addition modulo 2^64 followed by LSB is XOR share reconstruction.
S25 runtime does not return the complete mask to either party.

S25_runtime_facts.conclusion: NO_COMPLETE_MASK for tested prefixes only; not atomic no-output or all-or-nothing

options.name: F_TOPK-PREFIX
options.contract: A party receives z_b iff its API returns; the other party may already have returned; local unreturned shares remain in that party's view.

options.name: F_TOPK-ATOMIC
options.contract: Atomic durable escrow transaction makes both recipient shares available in one ideal transition; pre-commit both outputs are bottom; post-commit crash cannot roll back and shares remain recoverable.
options.required_architecture: Additional atomic coordination/escrow trust boundary; current markers do not prove this.

v3_contract.name: F_TOPK-ATOMIC
v3_contract.linearization_point: durable linearizable escrow A transaction commits both recipient-encrypted share records
v3_contract.before_commit: both ideal outputs are bottom; abort/timeout burns consumed material
v3_contract.at_commit: both recipient shares become durably available in the same ideal transition
v3_contract.after_commit_crash: no rollback; each recipient may recover its own encrypted record later
v3_contract.physical_fetch: asynchronous recovery; not the ideal output event
v3_contract.new_trust_boundary: A provides durable atomicity/availability; recipient encryption keys remain outside A
v3_contract.new_metadata_observer: L_A includes fixed ciphertext lengths, deposit/commit status, order and timing
v3_contract.client_fetch_semantics: Physical fetch may complete later; durable atomic commit is the ideal output transition and post-commit recovery does not change output to bottom.
v3_contract.preflight_sync: Each party preflights locally before lease consumption; the READY handshake carries only fixed-shape READY or the existing uniform ABORT outcome, with no local resource detail. Either preflight failure causes uniform pre-commit abort.
